description: **A releasable that has never been released is `unreleased`, and its releases are refused until the owner records it active.** The status is derived, never recorded: with no lifecycle period in effect, a releasable is active when its release archives record a release and unreleased when they do not. `release run`, `release resume`, `release retry`, and `monorepo release init` refuse an unreleased releasable, naming `rlsbl transition lifecycle --subject <name> --status active`, which allows its first release. `monorepo init`, `monorepo add`, `monorepo absorb`, and `migrate records` no longer open an active lifecycle period for a releasable; `transition lifecycle --status unreleased` is refused; and `status`, `monorepo status`, and `transition show` print each releasable's lifecycle status, recorded or derived.
**The lifecycle-and-license guide and the release workflow describe the derived `unreleased` status.**
**The help of `monorepo release init`, `release retry`, and `release resume`, and the monorepo guide, name the `unreleased` refusal.**
